The 2011 Jeep Grand Cherokee Laredo marked a pivotal moment for the iconic SUV, debuting a completely redesigned generation that elevated refinement and capability to new heights . This smooth and responsive powertrain is paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission and a robust Quadra-Trac I® 4WD system, featuring an electronic transfer case that provides seamless traction and capability in all driving conditions.

The well-equipped Laredo trim provides a solid foundation of comfort and functionality. It rides on 17-inch aluminum wheels with all-season tires and includes a leather-wrapped steering wheel with mounted audio and cruise controls. The spacious and versatile cabin offers comfortable seating for five with generous headroom and legroom, and provides 35.1 cubic feet of cargo space behind the second row, expanding to 68.7 cubic feet with the seats folded. Standard amenities include dual-zone manual climate control, power windows and door locks, heated mirrors, and a 6-speaker audio system with auxiliary input.

Jeep's engineering excellence is evident in its fully independent suspension system, providing a balance of on-road comfort and off-road composure. The Laredo also boasts a standard rearview camera, electronic stability control with electronic roll mitigation, 4-wheel anti-lock disc brakes, and a comprehensive airbag system for enhanced safety and confidence.

Engineered for accessible capability and everyday value, this Grand Cherokee achieves an EPA-estimated 16 MPG city and 22 MPG highway with its 24.6-gallon fuel tank. It also boasts a substantial 7,400-pound maximum towing capacity when properly equipped, cementing its position as a benchmark in the midsize SUV segment.

This 2013 Honda CR-V EX in gray is a dependable compact SUV that delivers the practicality and reliability buyers value in a pre-owned vehicle.

- Back up camera
- Clean Carfax
- Sunroof
- Power moonroof
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- Electronic stability control
- Traction control
- Front fog lights
- Alloy wheels
- Split folding rear seat
- Dual front impact airbags
- Remote keyless entry
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- AM/FM/CD audio system with 6 speakers
- Power door mirrors

This CR-V combines everyday functionality with genuine comfort features. The back up camera provides added convenience during parking and reversing, while the sunroof brings natural light and fresh air to the cabin. The split folding rear seat offers flexible cargo space to accommodate whatever you need to transport, and the power moonroof enhances the driving experience on pleasant days.

Under the hood, the 2.4L I4 DOHC 16V i-VTEC engine paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive provides solid performance and capability. The vehicle achieves 22 city MPG and 30 highway MPG, balancing efficiency with the utility you expect from this class. The four-wheel independent suspension and electronic stability control work together to deliver a stable, controlled ride across various road conditions.

Safety and convenience are well represented throughout. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags protect occupants, while brake assist, ABS brakes, and traction control enhance your control in challenging driving situations. Features like power steering, power windows, and remote keyless entry make daily operation straightforward and user-friendly.

The interior prioritizes practicality with cloth seat trim, front bucket seats, and an overhead console with compass and trip computer. Air conditioning, rear window defroster, and variably intermittent wipers ensure comfort in all seasons. Front reading lights and illuminated entry contribute to visibility and convenience.

This CR-V represents solid transportation with a proven track record. We invite you to inspect it and take it for a test drive to experience its capabilities firsthand.

Plus TT&L. Prices include $225 dealer doc fee, $499 Forever Start, and $499 LoJack 1-Year.

This 2013 Honda CR-V EX-L combines practical design with everyday reliability. The brown exterior presents a timeless appearance that complements its versatile nature as a compact crossover. With 153,554 miles, this vehicle carries real-world experience while remaining capable of delivering dependable service for years to come. The CR-V's reputation for longevity makes it a sensible choice for buyers seeking value without compromise.

The engineering behind this CR-V reflects Honda's commitment to balanced performance. The 2.4L I4 DOHC 16V i-VTEC engine pairs with a 5-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive to handle varying road conditions and weather. You can expect 22 city MPG and 30 highway MPG, providing efficiency on both commutes and longer drives. The four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering contribute to responsive handling while maintaining comfort during daily driving.

Inside, the EX-L trim delivers comfort and convenience features designed to enhance your driving experience. Heated front bucket seats with leather trim welcome you each morning, while the power moonroof adds natural light and airiness to the cabin. Automatic temperature control with dual front zone air conditioning allows driver and passenger to set independent preferences. The power driver seat enables personalized positioning, and the telescoping steering wheel accommodates various body types and preferences.

Technology and safety receive equal attention in this CR-V. The AM/FM/CD audio system with XM Radio keeps you connected during drives, enhanced by seven speakers distributing sound throughout the cabin. Steering wheel mounted audio controls let you manage entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel. The exterior parking camera rear aids visibility when backing up, while electronic stability control and brake assist work together to help maintain vehicle control in challenging situations.

The practical elements that make the CR-V a popular choice remain apparent throughout. Dual front airbags, side impact airbags, and overhead airbags surround occupants with protection. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power. The split folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs, and the roof rack rails expand your carrying capacity. Remote keyless entry, illuminated entry, and delay-off headlights add convenience to daily ownership.

Our Bremerton, WA Honda dealership, part of West Hills Auto Plex, has served the Seattle Area and the Kitsap Peninsula for years, providing new and used Honda sales, service and parts to drivers from the Bainbridge Island, Silverdale, Port Orchard, Gig Harbor, Poulsbo areas and beyond. While our extensive inventory of new and used Honda vehicles makes us a great place to buy in Bremerton, it's our friendly staff and customer-first attitude that keeps our customers coming back year after year.

This 2008 Acura MDX 3.7L SH-AWD presents a three-row luxury crossover designed for families seeking comfort and capability. The gray exterior combines practical sophistication with the vehicle's all-wheel-drive system, ready to handle varied driving conditions throughout the year.

The interior reflects Acura's commitment to premium comfort. Heated front sport seats with power adjustment and memory settings ensure every drive feels tailored to your preferences. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the leather-trimmed surfaces and heated door mirrors add refinement to daily commutes. The split-bench third-row seats provide flexible seating for up to seven passengers, making this vehicle accommodating for larger families or those who frequently transport multiple occupants.

Technology and convenience features integrate seamlessly into your driving experience. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your hands where they belong, while the Acura AM/FM stereo with XM Satellite Radio and CD player provides entertainment options. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare during night driving, and remote keyless entry simplifies access. The power steering and automatic temperature control with dual front and rear zones ensure comfort for all occupants.

Safety and reliability shine throughout this vehicle. The accident-free history and clean Carfax report provide confidence in the MDX's past. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system work together to protect occupants. Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering delivers responsive handling, while the four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide dependable stopping power.

Driving dynamics benefit from the 3.7L V6 engine paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission, delivering 15 city and 20 highway mpg. The 18-inch aluminum alloy wheels contribute to both the vehicle's aesthetic appeal and its road presence.

This 2020 Jeep Grand Cherokee Limited offers the capability and comfort you expect from a recognized SUV, delivered in a well-equipped package ready for your next adventure.

- Leather Trimmed Bucket Seats with heated front seats and power adjustment
- Uconnect 4C Navigation system with 8.4" touchscreen display
- GPS Navigation with SiriusXM Traffic Plus and Travel Link
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Premium audio system with SiriusXM Satellite Radio and 6 speakers
- Power moonroof for open-air driving
- ParkView rear backup camera for convenient parking
- Climate control with dual-zone automatic temperature management
- Heated steering wheel for cold-weather comfort
- Remote keyless entry and power liftgate
- Four-wheel independent suspension for responsive handling
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- 18-inch alloy wheels

The 2020 Grand Cherokee Limited combines practicality with thoughtful design. Its 3.6L V6 engine delivers 19 city and 26 highway MPG, balancing performance with reasonable fuel efficiency. The RWD platform provides confident handling on various road conditions, while the eight-speed automatic transmission ensures smooth acceleration and control throughout your drive.

Your comfort remains a priority in this vehicle. Dual-zone automatic climate control maintains your preferred temperature, while the heated steering wheel and heated front seats add warmth on chilly mornings. The split-folding rear seat expands cargo flexibility when you need to transport larger items, and the power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily routine. The Uconnect 4C system displays navigation, entertainment, and vehicle information on its 8.4-inch touchscreen. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto allow you to access your phone's apps and functions safely while driving. SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained with diverse programming options, and the integrated voice command system lets you control functions hands-free.

Safety features throughout the cabin provide added peace of mind. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags work together with Electronic Stability Control and traction control to help protect occupants. The rear backup camera assists with visibility when reversing, and the security system adds protection when the vehicle is parked.

This 2020 Grand Cherokee Limited represents a solid choice for buyers seeking a versatile SUV with modern convenience features and reliable construction. We invite you to visit our showroom to inspect this vehicle in person and arrange a test drive that demonstrates its capabilities firsthand.

Safety features include dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbag, and overhead airbag protection. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, traction control, and brake assist provide confident stopping power. The emergency communication system through SYNC 3 911 Assist offers additional peace of mind.

With Equipment Group 200A, heated door mirrors, and power door mirrors, this SE trim provides thoughtful conveniences. The compass and trip computer offer useful information for navigation and efficiency tracking. This Escape represents practical value for drivers seeking a well-equipped, dependable compact SUV.

This 2017 Honda Pilot EX-L offers a well-rounded package for families and individuals seeking a capable three-row SUV with proven reliability and practical design.

- 3.5L V6 engine with 6-speed automatic transmission and AWD
- 7-speaker audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Automatic dual-zone climate control with rear air conditioning
- Heated and cooled leather front seats
- Rearview camera with parking assistance
- Power moonroof
- 18-inch alloy wheels
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- 3rd row split-bench seating for flexible passenger configurations

- HondaLink emergency communication system

The Pilot delivers solid fuel economy at 18 city and 26 highway MPG, making it practical for both daily commutes and longer journeys. The all-wheel-drive system provides confident handling across varying road conditions, while the spacious interior accommodates up to eight passengers with the flexible seating arrangement. Three rows mean you'll have the versatility to handle school runs, weekend trips, or family gatherings without compromise.

The EX-L trim emphasizes comfort with heated and cooled leather-trimmed seats, automatic temperature control, and a power moonroof that floods the cabin with natural light. The power-adjustable driver and passenger seats allow each occupant to find their ideal position, while the heated front seats add warmth during colder months. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and a comprehensive gauge cluster keep important information within easy view.

Safety is addressed through multiple airbags, including front, side, and overhead protection. The 4-wheel disc braking system with ABS, electronic stability control, traction control, and occupant sensing airbags form a well-equipped protective suite. The rearview camera makes backing up simpler, while the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about tire condition.

Connectivity features integrate your smartphone seamlessly through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing navigation and communication without distraction. The SiriusXM satellite radio provides entertainment options across the country, and the garage door transmitter eliminates fumbling for remotes in the driveway.

This 2017 Pilot EX-L represents a practical choice for those prioritizing space, comfort, and capability in a mature SUV platform. We invite you to visit our showroom to inspect the vehicle in person and discuss ownership options that align with your needs.

These are typically older trade-ins or higher-mileage units. No warranty. No promises. Big savings. If you're handy, budget-savvy, or shopping for a basic commuter, this lane can be a win. What You're Getting (and Not Getting) You get: Rock-bottom pricing-often below typical retail book values. Full transparency about what we know right now (intake notes, basic observations). Access to pre-purchase inspections-bring your mechanic or arrange a mobile inspection. Clean title disclosure (as available) and standard sale paperwork. You don't get: No warranty, expressed or implied (as permitted by Tennessee law). No reconditioning (no fresh tires/brakes/fluids unless noted). No cosmetic fixes (expect dings, scratches, stained seats, etc.). No promises about future repairs-you're taking on that risk. Translation: You're trading certainty for price. Who This Program Is For (...and not for) A good fit if you: Want the lowest possible purchase price and accept repair risk. Are comfortable with DIY fixes or have a trusted shop. Need a work truck, second car, teen's first car, or basic runabout. Are okay with cosmetic wear and potential mechanical needs. Not a good fit if you: Want turn-key reliability and retail-level reconditioning. Prefer warranty coverage or certified pre-owned standards. Don't have budget set aside for repairs after purchase. Typical Inventory You'll See Higher-mileage trade-ins that still run and drive. Vehicles with cosmetic issues (hail, faded paint, worn interiors). Units needing maintenance (tires, brakes, sensors, leaks). Niche/older models that aren't worth retail recon. Inventory changes daily-first-come, first-served. How to Buy Browse our Wholesale List and pick a few VINs to inspect. Review our intake notes and arrange your pre-purchase inspection (optional, recommended). Decide and buy-cash or certified funds preferred. Some lenders may finance older, high-mileage, as-is vehicles, approvals vary. Trades welcome. Taxes, tags, and fees apply. Radical Transparency (Read This Before You Visit) AS-IS = You own it, with all faults, at delivery. We encourage inspections. We do a basic intake evaluation so the car can be moved safely on-lot, but we don't diagnose everything. Expect unknowns. Price reflects condition and risk. If we reconditioned it, the price would be higher-this program skips that step on purpose. FAQ Is \Wholesale to the Public\ the same as an auction? No. You get auction-style pricing without needing a dealer's license. You inspect and buy directly from us. Can I get it inspected? Yes. Bring your mechanic or schedule a mobile inspection to our lot before you buy. Can I add a warranty later? Most third-party warranties require a qualifying inspection and vehicle criteria. For older/high-mileage units, coverage may be limited or unavailable. Ask, but plan as if there's no warranty. Why are these so cheap? Because we bypass reconditioning and price in the known and unknown repairs you may need to handle. Do you negotiate? Pricing is already discounted to move quickly. If you want ultra-low price, this is it, if you want fully reconditioned, shop our retail used inventory. Do you offer financing? Sometimes. Some banks won't finance older/high-mileage AS-IS units. If financing is a must, talk to us early.

The interior design balances form and function. description: Wholesale to the Public: AS-IS Used Cars at Deep Discounts \Wholesale to the Public\ means you're buying a vehicle as-is, at a steeply discounted price, before we spend time and money reconditioning it for retail. These are typically older trade-ins or higher-mileage units. No warranty. No promises. Big savings. If you're handy, budget-savvy, or shopping for a basic commuter, this lane can be a win. What You're Getting (and Not Getting) You get: Rock-bottom pricing-often below typical retail book values. Full transparency about what we know right now (intake notes, basic observations). Access to pre-purchase inspections-bring your mechanic or arrange a mobile inspection. Clean title disclosure (as available) and standard sale paperwork. You don't get: No warranty, expressed or implied (as permitted by Tennessee law). No reconditioning (no fresh tires/brakes/fluids unless noted). No cosmetic fixes (expect dings, scratches, stained seats, etc.). No promises about future repairs-you're taking on that risk. Translation: You're trading certainty for price. Who This Program Is For (...and not for) A good fit if you: Want the lowest possible purchase price and accept repair risk. Are comfortable with DIY fixes or have a trusted shop. Need a work truck, second car, teen's first car, or basic runabout. Are okay with cosmetic wear and potential mechanical needs. Not a good fit if you: Want turn-key reliability and retail-level reconditioning. Prefer warranty coverage or certified pre-owned standards. Don't have budget set aside for repairs after purchase. Typical Inventory You'll See Higher-mileage trade-ins that still run and drive. Vehicles with cosmetic issues (hail, faded paint, worn interiors). Units needing maintenance (tires, brakes, sensors, leaks). Niche/older models that aren't worth retail recon. Inventory changes daily-first-come, first-served. How to Buy Browse our Wholesale List and pick a few VINs to inspect. Review our intake notes and arrange your pre-purchase inspection (optional, recommended). Decide and buy-cash or certified funds preferred. Some lenders may finance older, high-mileage, as-is vehicles, approvals vary. Trades welcome. Taxes, tags, and fees apply. Radical Transparency (Read This Before You Visit) AS-IS = You own it, with all faults, at delivery. We encourage inspections. We do a basic intake evaluation so the car can be moved safely on-lot, but we don't diagnose everything. Expect unknowns. Price reflects condition and risk. If we reconditioned it, the price would be higher-this program skips that step on purpose. FAQ Is \Wholesale to the Public\ the same as an auction? No. You get auction-style pricing without needing a dealer's license. You inspect and buy directly from us. Can I get it inspected? Yes. Bring your mechanic or schedule a mobile inspection to our lot before you buy. Can I add a warranty later? Most third-party warranties require a qualifying inspection and vehicle criteria. For older/high-mileage units, coverage may be limited or unavailable. Ask, but plan as if there's no warranty. Why are these so cheap? Because we bypass reconditioning and price in the known and unknown repairs you may need to handle. Do you negotiate? Pricing is already discounted to move quickly. If you want ultra-low price, this is it, if you want fully reconditioned, shop our retail used inventory. Do you offer financing? Sometimes. Some banks won't finance older/high-mileage AS-IS units. If financing is a must, talk to us early.

This CR-V combines practical utility with genuine comfort, offering a solid foundation for daily driving. This 2007 Ford Edge SEL delivers the capability and comfort you need for every journey on the road.

- AM/FM Stereo with CD player and MP3 compatibility
- 3.5L V6 engine with 6-speed automatic transmission
- All-wheel drive for confident handling in various conditions
- Power driver seat with adjustable positioning
- Remote keyless entry for convenient access
- Leather-wrapped steering wheel
- Front fog lights for enhanced visibility
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- Speed-sensing steering
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror with compass
- 17" alloy wheels
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags
- Split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo space

The Edge stands out as a capable crossover designed to handle both daily commutes and weekend adventures. Its 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission provides the balance of performance and efficiency you expect, returning up to 24 miles per gallon on the highway. The all-wheel drive system ensures responsive handling across different road conditions throughout the year.

Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully designed cabin with front bucket seats upholstered in cloth and an intuitive layout. The power-adjustable driver seat allows you to find your ideal driving position, while the tilt and telescoping steering wheel accommodates various preferences. Climate control keeps everyone comfortable, and the speed-sensitive wipers adjust automatically based on vehicle speed.

Safety has been prioritized with a comprehensive airbag system including dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags. ABS brakes and electronic stability control work together to provide responsive braking and stability during challenging driving situations. The low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about your tire condition.

The infotainment system features an AM/FM stereo with a six-disc CD changer and MP3 capability, controlled conveniently through steering wheel-mounted audio controls. The trip computer provides useful data about your driving, while illuminated entry lights make accessing your vehicle simple at any time of day.

We invite you to experience what this Edge can offer your lifestyle. Contact us to schedule a closer look at this versatile crossover and discover why it remains a solid choice for those seeking space, capability, and reliable performance.

Dual-zone automatic climate control ensures all passengers maintain their preferred temperature, and the telescoping tilt steering wheel allows you to find your ideal driving position.

Safety features provide comprehensive protection, including dual front and side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. The electronic stability control and traction control systems work together to enhance grip and control, while the 4-wheel disc brake system with ABS provides confident stopping power.

Standard convenience features include cruise control, power windows and steering, remote keyless entry, and an overhead console with ambient lighting. The roof rack expands cargo versatility, while the rear window defroster and wiper ensure clear visibility in inclement weather.

We invite you to visit our dealership to inspect this RAV4 Limited and take it for a test drive. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you determine if this vehicle meets your transportation needs.

Genuine wood trim accents on the console and door panels add refinement to the driving environment.

Safety is central to the RX 350s design. Multiple airbag systems including dual front impact, side-impact, knee, and overhead airbags work alongside electronic stability control and traction control to help protect occupants. The four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering contribute to responsive handling and stability.

The cabin provides substantial connectivity and entertainment options. The 8-speaker audio system with AM/FM radio and CD player delivers clear sound quality, while steering wheel controls allow easy access to functions without taking your hands off the wheel. The HomeLink garage door transmitter adds everyday convenience.

This 2009 Ford Escape XLT in gray offers practical transportation for buyers seeking value. The vehicle is equipped with a Duratec 2.5L I4 engine paired with a 6-Speed Automatic transmission and all-wheel drive capability. With city fuel economy rated at 19 MPG and highway at 25 MPG, this Escape delivers reasonable efficiency for its class.

Inside, the XLT features front bucket seats with premium cloth upholstery and a 60/40 split folding rear seat, providing flexibility for passengers and cargo. The split folding rear seat expands your storage options when needed. Climate control is managed through air conditioning with a rear window defroster to maintain visibility in various weather conditions.

The cabin includes practical conveniences such as a tilt steering wheel, trip computer, and outside temperature display. Power-operated windows, a power driver seat, and remote keyless entry add daily functionality. The leather steering wheel and illuminated entry enhance the driving experience. Audio entertainment comes by way of AM/FM radio with SIRIUS Satellite Radio capability, a single CD/MP3 player, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls for easy access.

Safety systems on this Escape include electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags provide occupant protection. The vehicle rides on 16-inch 5-spoke cast aluminum alloy wheels and features four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering and front and rear anti-roll bars for handling stability.

External features include fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality, front fog lights, and a rear window wiper with variably intermittent wipers. Body-color bumpers and power door mirrors complete the exterior. An auto-dimming rear-view mirror and roof rack with rails offer additional practicality.

description:
This 2009 Toyota Highlander Limited offers practical three-row seating and capability for families seeking reliable transportation.

- 3.5L V6 engine with 5-speed automatic transmission and AWD
- Leather seat trim throughout
- Power front seats for driver and passenger
- Automatic climate control with front dual zone A/C
- Heated door mirrors with power adjustment
- Premium audio system with AM/FM/6 CD changer and 6 speakers
- Rear window defroster and rear window wiper
- Exterior parking camera
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- 19-inch aluminum alloy wheels
- Remote keyless entry with Homelink garage door transmitter
- Dual front airbags, side impact airbags, and overhead airbag protection

The Highlander Limited combines comfort with functionality. The three-row configuration accommodates up to eight passengers, with split-folding rear seats to balance seating and cargo flexibility. The leather interior reflects the Limited trim's premium appointments, while power adjustments on both front seats ensure each driver finds their optimal driving position. Dual-zone automatic climate control allows front-row occupants to set independent temperature preferences, and the rear window defroster helps maintain visibility in adverse weather.

Performance and handling benefit from the 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission. All-wheel drive provides enhanced traction across various road conditions. The four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars contributes to composed handling, while electronic stability control and traction control systems work together to maintain vehicle stability.

The comprehensive safety suite includes dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and brake assist technology. Anti-whiplash front head restraints offer additional occupant protection. The four-wheel disc braking system with ABS provides responsive stopping power, and the rear parking camera helps you navigate tight spaces with confidence.

- Google Maps Navigation System
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow

- 18 alloy wheels with matte shark gray inserts

This hybrid model delivers 50 city and 47 highway miles per gallon, making it an intelligent choice for drivers who value both fuel efficiency and performance. With its 2.0L 16V DOHC engine paired with an eCVT transmission, the Civic Hybrid provides responsive power while maintaining excellent economy for everyday driving and longer commutes.

The Sport Touring trim elevates your driving experience with premium appointments throughout the cabin. The leather-trimmed front bucket seats offer comfort and support, complemented by heated seating for morning drives. The power moonroof adds an open-air dimension to your commute, while the premium Bose sound system transforms your daily drive into an enjoyable experience. Climate control through dual-zone automatic temperature management ensures every passenger rides in comfort.

Your investment is protected through Hondas comprehensive certification program, which includes a 182-point inspection, roadside assistance, $0 warranty deductible, transferable warranty coverage, complete vehicle history report, 24-month/100,000-mile limited warranty following the new car warranty expiration, 84-month/100,000-mile powertrain limited warranty from original in-service date, Honda Care roadside assistance for two years/100,000 miles, two complimentary oil changes within the first year, and a SiriusXM 90-day trial.

Advanced safety features work continuously to protect you and your passengers. The vehicle includes dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, rear side impact airbags, and overhead airbags. Electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident handling in all conditions. The Blind Spot Information System and exterior parking camera add practical awareness when maneuvering in tight spaces.

This blue Sport Touring model with just 1,149 miles represents minimal use and effectively new condition. The exterior features 18 alloy wheels with distinctive matte shark gray accents, heated power mirrors with turn signal indicators, and fully automatic headlights with delay-off technology. Detailed craftsmanship extends to every touchpoint, from the leather shift knob to the tachometer and trip computer that keep you informed.

We invite you to schedule a test drive today to experience how this Civic Hybrid combines practical efficiency, thoughtful technology, and reliable Honda engineering. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you discover why this vehicle is the right choice for your future.
